title: 日本ダービーの後に・遠い背中

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower pulls out all the stops at the Japanese Derby, but she's still unable to catch up to Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets her sights on the long-distance Kikuka Sho as the stage for their rematch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This upcoming race will be make-or-break for a stayer like Rice Shower, so it's back to training for us.
